description: This file defines the ExpenseRepository class which provides an abstraction layer over the ExpenseDao for managing ExpenseEntity objects, including saving expenses and streaming all expenses.

classes.name: ExpenseRepository
classes.description: Repository providing an abstraction over ExpenseDao for offline operations, including saving expense entries and streaming all expenses.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an expense entry to the database and returns its row ID.

methods.name: streamAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow that streams all expense entities ordered by timestamp.
